module: Carry out and maintain the assessment

lesson.title: Perform internal control
lesson.summary: Perform the internal checks rather than substituting a certificate purchase.

prerequisites.reason: The internal-control duty depends on the relevant Annex III points and route.
Internal assessment needs the applicable requirements and supporting evidence. Consistency must be checked against the identified technical records.

blocks: **Internal control** under Article 43(2) is the AI Act conformity procedure for Annex III points 2–8. Annex VI does not provide for a notified body. Northbridge's stipulated employment route falls here. This does not exclude other legal requirements, voluntary advice or a separate applicable sector route.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 43(2); Annex VI(1)–(4)

blocks: The provider verifies its **quality management system**—the documented processes and responsibilities for achieving and maintaining compliance—against Article 17. It examines technical documentation to assess the relevant Chapter III Section 2 requirements. Calling the process internal does not make it optional or unrecorded.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 43(2); Annex VI(1)–(4)

blocks: **Design-file consistency** means the actual design and development process and post-market monitoring agree with the technical documentation. If Northbridge's file promises a human override that the released interface lacks, the inconsistency needs correction and evidence, not merely a signature.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 43(2); Annex VI(1)–(4)

blocks: Record the checks, findings, gaps and corrective decisions. Verify the current legal version: Article 43(6) permits future delegated changes to procedures for Annex III points 2–8, and Article 43(5) permits updates to Annexes VI and VII. The retained baseline is not a promise that the route can never change.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 43(2); Annex VI(1)–(4)
